set.t: North Bend sits in the Black River bottoms; an 1890s Jackson County plat or the 1900 census might place Randall's land. Permission: private land, ask first. Wire story (eight Wisconsin copies, 30 Oct-9 Nov 1901) plus the local Badger State Banner obituary; no estate notice or find.

src: Badger State Banner (Black River Falls), 31 Oct 1901, p. 5 (GenealogyBank)
tw-randall-north-bend-1901.st: The local Badger State Banner (31 Oct 1901) dates his death to 23 Oct and says a brother came from Minnesota for the funeral, against the wire's 'no relatives'.
